description: This PHP class 'RequestFactory' in the namespace 'League\OAuth2\Client\Tool' provides methods to create PSR-7 HTTP Request instances, including handling simplified options and merging default parameters.

classes.name: RequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create PSR-7 Request instances with support for simplified options.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PSR-7 Request with specified parameters.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Merges user-supplied options with default request options.

methods.name: getRequestWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 Request using a method, URI, and simplified options array.
